title: Overtone style pack
description: pack.json of a caption style pack for videojs-overtone. See docs/contributing/style-packs.md.

name.description: The theme name: the folder name, the CSS scope .ot-theme-<name> and the plugin option theme: '<name>'.

title.description: Short display name for the gallery and the demo's theme menu.

description.description: One or two sentences: the look and what it is for.

author.description: Your name or handle, optionally with a URL: "Jane Doe (https://example.com)".

license.description: Packs in this repository are MIT licensed, like the rest of the project.

tags.description: What the pack is for. Add a new tag to this list in the same pull request if none fits.

contrast.description: How the pack keeps text legible, with the lowest ratio the tests report (npm run test:styles).
